correctness.rationale: The twist and individual idempotence force two-sided annihilation. The resulting k-square Munn algebra with sandwich rank t and defect s has precisely q^(2sr) lifts of every rank-r projection. For two idempotents, the product rank is exactly rank(PQ), independent of radical lift choices. The image W of the rank-u projection Q determines product rank v by dim(W intersection ker P)=u-v; the Gaussian intersection formula counts every W and q^(u(t-u)) complementary kernels. Multiplication of all factors gives each asserted coefficient and support. Direct exhaustive checks succeeded in 24 full ambient finite-field cases and all 3^9 elements of a t=2,s=1 Munn algebra, without conflating finite tests with proof.

value.rationale: Ranks of products of idempotents govern multiplication behavior in the idempotent-generated matrix semigroup and are not determined by the number of commuting pairs. The theorem gives every possible rank triple and exact count for every finite field, defining matrix, and nontrivial twist, with a real kernel-image defect effect q^(2s(r+u)). The t=2,s=1 family already exhibits 2916 zero-product and 8748 rank-one-product pairs among rank-one factors. This is a motivated exact complete invariant rather than an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
